source.quote: SMSL's own page for the RAW-MDA1, read 2026-11-27 with curl, « Introduction » bullets: « 2 pieces of ESS new generation high-end DAC chip ES9039Q2M; »; « The brand-new third-generation XMOS XU-316, supports up to PCM 32bit/768kHz and DSD512; »; « Input ports (except Bluetooth) support MQA and DSD, coaxial and optical support DoP64; »; « Adapts the latest Bluetooth chip of Qualcomm, supports LDAC 24bit/96kHz, APTX/HD, SBC and AAC; »

facts.chip: Two ESS ES9039Q2M (« 2 pieces of ESS new generation high-end DAC chip ES9039Q2M »), XMOS XU-316 on USB.

_the_ceiling_is_the_XMOS_bullet: The rate and DSD ceilings come from the bullet naming the XMOS USB receiver, so they are written on usb only. No other input is given a PCM rate: the page states none.
_optical_has_DoP64_and_no_rate: Optical and coaxial get DoP64 from the maker's own clause and no PCM ceiling, because none is stated: copying 768 kHz onto optical is the error vocabulary/why-the-optical-default-stays-low.json exists to prevent.
